title: Reddit r/Jokes preference pairs
authors: Reddit r/Jokes posters; dataset packaging by SocialGrep
hidden_reason: Excluded from DPO v6: humor-aligned but off-rubric for Mallard's 'thoughtful spoken peer' voice — it caused the v5 regression. Kept as a contrast set, not as training signal.
note: Derived by pairing high-upvote vs low-upvote posts. CC-BY-4.0 covers SocialGrep's compilation; individual Reddit posters retain rights in their own submissions and no per-author credit was captured at ingest. Much of r/Jokes is recycled folk material with no identifiable author.
